authority_domains: Directorate General of Shipping / Merchant Shipping Act
Indian Coast Guard (ICG) / Marine Environment Protection

documents.title: IHO Standards for Hydrographic Surveys (Edition 6.2.0, October 2024)
documents.topic: Hydrographic Survey Standards, Feature Detection & Total Uncertainty Bounds
impact_mechanisms: Order 1a requirement: Total Horizontal Uncertainty (THU) <= 5m + 5% of water depth at 95% confidence level
Order 1a requirement: Total Vertical Uncertainty (TVU) <= sqrt(0.5^2 + (0.013 * depth)^2)
Mandatory feature detection: Detection of cubic features > 2m in depths up to 40m, or 10% of depth in deeper water
Mandatory sound velocity profile (SVP) calibration and acoustic ray-tracing refraction correction
documents.material_degradation_profile: Standard hydrographic survey benchmark; defines statutory survey quality tiers from Special Order (harbors) to Order 2 (offshore).
documents.recommended_mitigation: Flag any candidate within 15m of surface in navigable water as HAZNAV; conduct orthogonal verification swath prior to nautical chart update.
documents.source_reference: IHO S-44 Standards for Hydrographic Surveys, Edition 6.2.0 (October 2024); IHO Hydrographic Dictionary S-32

documents.title: National Marine Litter Assessment & Monitoring Protocol for Indian Coastal Waters
documents.organization: Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) / National Centre for Coastal Research (NCCR)
documents.authority: MoES Marine Litter Directorate, Government of India
documents.jurisdiction: Territorial Waters & EEZ of India (7,516 km Coastline)
documents.topic: Benthic Marine Litter Density, Classification & Ecological Risk Assessment
documents.debris_type: Plastic / Ghost Net / General Marine Litter
impact_mechanisms: High benthic accumulation of polymer fishing gear and macro-plastics along peninsular Indian shelf
Ecological vulnerability index prioritization for Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve, Palk Bay, and Andaman coral reefs
Benthic smothering and physical abrasion of coral polyps and endangered dugong feeding grounds
Fragmentation into bioavailable microplastics entering Indian coastal commercial fisheries
documents.material_degradation_profile: Synthetic polymers (nylon, polypropylene, HDPE); benthic half-life 400-600 years without solar photodegradation.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Non-destructive ROV recovery in Marine Protected Areas; coordinate with state fisheries departments for ghost net buy-back logging.
documents.source_reference: NCCR-MoES Technical Report on Marine Litter in Coastal Waters of India (2022); Swachh Sagar Surakshit Sagar Campaign Baseline

documents.title: Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 — Part XIII: Wreck, Salvage and Navigational Safety
documents.organization: Directorate General of Shipping / Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
documents.authority: Government of India Statutory Maritime Authority
documents.jurisdiction: Indian Territorial Waters, Port Approaches & Traffic Separation Schemes
documents.topic: Statutory Reporting of Wrecks, Lost Cargo Containers, and Notice to Mariners (NOTMAR)
impact_mechanisms: Statutory duty of Receiver of Wreck to investigate and secure all submerged wrecks and lost cargo
Mandatory immediate broadcast of Navigational Warnings (NOTMAR / NAVAREA VIII) for obstructions with Under-Keel Clearance < 14.5m in shipping lanes
Liability and salvage rights assignment under Maritime Salvage Convention and Indian Admiralty Jurisdiction Act 2017
Shipowner liability for removal of wrecks and lost containerized cargo obstructing navigation
documents.material_degradation_profile: Statutory legal framework; mandates formal inter-agency clearance before closing an incident.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Issue draft NOTMAR to NHO Dehradun and Coastal Radio Stations; notify Port Captain / VTS operator for immediate navigation broadcast.
documents.source_reference: Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 (Act No. 44 of 1958), Sections 390-404; Indian Admiralty (Jurisdiction and Settlement of Maritime Claims) Act, 2017

documents.title: National Oil Spill Disaster Contingency Plan (NOS-DCP) & Marine Pollution Response Protocol
documents.authority: Directorate of Marine Environment, Coast Guard Headquarters
documents.topic: Marine Pollution Emergency Response for Hazardous Containers, Chemical Drums, and Fuel Bunkers
impact_mechanisms: Tier 1 (Local port) to Tier 3 (National emergency) response protocol for hazardous submerged cargo breach
Hydrocarbon leakage from sunken vessel bunker fuel tanks causing slick migration toward coastal mangrove estuaries
Chemical drum rupture and toxic plume dispersion requiring underwater acoustic exclusion zone
documents.material_degradation_profile: Steel container/drum structural integrity assessment; galvanic corrosion rate 0.1-0.2 mm/year in warm tropical coastal waters.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Dispatch Pollution Control Vessel (ICGS Samudra Prahari / ICGS Samudra Paheridar); deploy containment booms if surface sheen detected.
documents.source_reference: ICG NOS-DCP Manual (2023); National Disaster Management Plan for Marine Chemical & Oil Emergencies

documents.title: Guidelines for Marine Litter & Ghost Gear Remediation under Plastic Waste Management Rules
documents.authority: Hazardous Waste & Plastic Management Division, Government of India
documents.jurisdiction: Coastal States & Union Territories of India
documents.topic: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) & Environmentally Sound Salvage of Marine Synthetic Waste
impact_mechanisms: Tracking of end-of-life fishing gear under Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) framework
Protocol for onshore decontamination, sorting, and co-processing in cement kilns or mechanical recycling
Mandatory geocoding and weight estimation for municipal and state maritime board salvage logs
documents.material_degradation_profile: Polyamide (nylon 6, nylon 66) and vulcanized rubber; thermal recycling and pyrolysis viability standards.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Generate CPCB-compliant Salvage Manifest with estimated tonnage, polymer type, and authorized coastal recycling partner ID.
documents.source_reference: CPCB Guidelines on Plastic Waste Management (2021/2024 Amendments); Environment (Protection) Act, 1986

documents.title: Territorial Waters, Continental Shelf, EEZ and Other Maritime Zones Act, 1976
documents.organization: Parliament of India / Ministry of External Affairs
documents.authority: Government of India Sovereign Maritime Law
documents.topic: Sovereign Jurisdiction over Seabed Exploration, Underwater Cultural Heritage, and Debris Removal
impact_mechanisms: Exclusive sovereign rights to explore, exploit, conserve and manage seabed resources across the 200 nautical mile EEZ
Jurisdiction to protect and preserve the marine environment and prevent oceanic pollution
Protection of historic shipwrecks and underwater cultural heritage in contiguous and continental shelf zones
documents.material_degradation_profile: Constitutional and statutory jurisdiction defining legal permissions for underwater salvage operations.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Verify whether wreck candidate has archaeological/heritage status (ASI / NHO registry) prior to authorizing commercial recovery.
documents.source_reference: The Territorial Waters, Continental Shelf, Exclusive Economic Zone and Other Maritime Zones Act, 1976 (Act 80 of 1976)

documents.title: Regulations for the Prevention of Pollution by Garbage from Ships (Resolution MEPC.310(73))
documents.topic: Mandatory Prohibition of Synthetic Garbage Discharge & Container Loss Reporting
impact_mechanisms: Complete global ban on discharge of all plastics, synthetic ropes, and fishing gear into the sea
Mandatory recording of accidental loss of fishing gear and cargo containers in the Garbage Record Book
Flag state and coastal state obligation to report loss coordinates to the IMO Global Integrated Shipping Information System (GISIS)
documents.material_degradation_profile: International treaty compliance standard for commercial shipping fleets operating in Indian waters.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Cross-reference detected container targets with IMO GISIS lost container casualty reports to establish cargo manifest.
documents.source_reference: IMO Resolution MEPC.310(73); MARPOL Consolidated Edition Annex V (Prevention of Pollution by Garbage)

documents.title: Impact of Submerged Tyres and Artificial Reef Deployments on Benthic Habitats
impact_mechanisms: Leaching of 6PPD-quinone and heavy metals (zinc, sulfur compounds) toxic to marine teleosts
Mobile wave scouring and mechanical abrasion of benthic substrates during storm events
Slow fragmentation into persistent synthetic micro-rubber elastomers (>200 year decomposition half-life)
documents.material_degradation_profile: Vulcanized polyisoprene; extremely resistant to microbial degradation; subject to mechanical shearing and photodegradation in photic zones.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Targeted ROV/diver recovery without dragging across sensitive benthic epifauna; prioritize recovery from coral or seagrass beds.
documents.source_reference: NOAA MDP Report No. MD-2020-04; EPA Aquatic Life Ambient Water Quality Criteria

documents.title: Intermodal Freight Units Lost at Sea: Guidelines for Reporting and Environmental Hazard Assessment
documents.topic: Intermodal Container Salvage & Submerged Navigation Obstruction
impact_mechanisms: Acute navigation hazard for small vessels and submarine telecommunication cables
Potential rupture of hazardous container cargo (industrial chemicals, consumer electronics, lithium batteries)
Localised galvanic corrosion and galvanic metal ion enrichment around benthic footprint
documents.material_degradation_profile: Cor-ten structural steel with industrial marine primer; hull breach estimated in 10-30 years depending on salinity, depth, and oxygen saturation.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Acoustic side-scan sonar re-survey to confirm hull integrity before heavy lift crane cable tethering.
documents.source_reference: IMO Circular MSC.1/Circ.1625 (2021); World Shipping Council Containers Lost at Sea Report

documents.title: Potentially Polluting Wrecks in Marine Waters: Risk Assessment and Prioritization
documents.organization: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) & US Coast Guard
documents.topic: Shipwreck Hull Integrity and Bunker Fuel Mitigation
impact_mechanisms: Catastrophic or chronic release of heavy fuel oil (HFO), lubricating oils, and toxic ballast water
Trawl gear entanglement hazard creating secondary ghost fishing traps across wreck superstructure
Dual ecological role: toxicant source vs artificial reef substrate for benthic assemblages
documents.material_degradation_profile: Ferrous keel and plate structure subject to sulphate-reducing bacteria and anaerobic corrosion; collapse rate variable by depth.
documents.recommended_mitigation: Multi-beam and SSS non-invasive structural assessment; fuel containment hot-tapping if hydrocarbons detected.
documents.source_reference: NOAA OR&R Potentially Polluting Wrecks Assessment (2019); IMO Nairobi International Convention on Wreck Removal

documents.title: Submerged Aircraft Recovery & Environmental Impact Protocol
documents.organization: International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) & Marine Salvage Bureau
documents.topic: Derelict Aircraft Fuselage and Hazardous Avionics in Deep Water
impact_mechanisms: Aviation kerosene / hydraulic fluid release and battery electrolyte dispersion
Carbon-fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) splintering causing localized micro-fiber contamination
Primary legal/forensic priority often overriding standard ecological schedules
documents.material_degradation_profile: Aluminum-lithium alloys and CFRP composite skins; aluminum experiences rapid pit corrosion in hyper-saline benthic environments.
documents.recommended_mitigation: AUV side-scan grid mapping with 200% swath overlap; recovery with padded lifting slings to preserve forensic structure.
documents.source_reference: ICAO Manual of Aircraft Accident and Incident Investigation (Doc 9756)

documents.title: Abandoned, Lost or Otherwise Discarded Fishing Gear (ALDFG): Global Assessment and Mitigation
documents.authority: FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture Technical Paper
documents.topic: Ghost Fishing and Benthic Smothering by Derelict Fishing Gear
impact_mechanisms: Continuous unmonitored mortality of endangered marine fauna (turtles, cetaceans, apex predators)
Smothering and breaking of biogenic reef colonies (stony corals, gorgonians, sponges)
High emission rate of macro- and micro-nylon / polypropylene synthetic fibers
documents.material_degradation_profile: High-density polyethylene (HDPE) and nylon filaments; UV-shielded at benthic depths, persisting for 400-600 years.
documents.recommended_mitigation: High priority emergency recovery using ROV hook cutter attachments; avoidance of seafloor bottom dragging.
documents.source_reference: FAO Technical Paper No. 600; Global Ghost Gear Initiative (GGGI) Best Practice Framework

documents.title: Submerged Concrete Structures, Coastal Ruins, and Artificial Substrates in Marine Environments
documents.topic: Submerged Structural Ruin Substrate Alteration and Encrustation
impact_mechanisms: Alteration of local hydrodynamic currents and sediment transport deposition patterns
Initial alkaline leaching (calcium hydroxide) during early immersion, stabilizing over time
Potential substrate provision for invasive benthic fouling species
documents.material_degradation_profile: Portland cement and aggregate matrix; physical spalling under wave energy; stable over multiple centuries at depth.
documents.recommended_mitigation: In-situ monitoring; physical removal only if obstructing commercial navigational fairways or port channels.
documents.source_reference: UNEP Guidelines on Artificial Reefs and Coastal Structures (2023)
